rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=20, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=5, itnet_alpha=0.1, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-1 ONBOARDING of ItNet v1 (solver_itnet.py: pretrain SmallUNet FBP->truth denoiser, then FIXED analytic k-iter DC unroll at eval; only trainable component is the UNet) on the re-split Breast-CT (train 3600 / val 200 / test 200, seed 20260703). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: none (first iter). (2) Failure mode: N/A onboarding; goal = does v1 run on breast 128-view 512^2 and clear the sparse-view FBP baseline (hr>0). ItNet v1 is the Mayo test champion (hr 0.3756), so breast (synthetic, cleaner) should clear easily. (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a conservative UNet(c=16, 20 pretrain epochs, lr 1e-3) on 400 train scenes will clear breast FBP (hr>0) and land ssim ~0.9+, because v1 cleared demo_dl/breast trivially before and the sparse-view FBP baseline leaves large headroom. (5) BUDGET: train_n=400 x 20 epochs SmallUNet(c=16) at 512^2 + 200-slice k=5 DC val pass; breast uses a single shared PYRO-NN projector (no per-sample-ps swap unlike Mayo), FBP batched -> well inside 20 min. val_n=200 = the FULL new breast val split (was 400; capped to <=200 per re-split; part of onboarding, not a separate knob). (6) Loop continues; iter-2 dispatched on landing. grad_clip=1.0 retained (DC adjoint safety).
